response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT p.PlaylistId, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM Playlist p LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId) SELECT PlaylistId, TrackCount, TrackCount * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(TrackCount * 1.0) FROM c), 0) AS Ratio FROM c ORDER BY (Ratio IS NULL), Ratio DESC, PlaylistId LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The average tracks per playlist is taken over all playlists in the Playlist table, including empty ones, which count as 0 tracks.
Ties in ratio are broken by PlaylistId ascending. A zero average gives a NULL ratio, which sorts last.

alternatives.interpretation: The average is taken only over playlists that have at least one track, so empty playlists are excluded from the average.
alternatives.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT PlaylistId, COUNT(TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM PlaylistTrack GROUP BY PlaylistId) SELECT PlaylistId, TrackCount, TrackCount * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(TrackCount * 1.0) FROM c), 0) AS Ratio FROM c ORDER BY (Ratio IS NULL), Ratio DESC, PlaylistId LIMIT 10
